name: Guangzhou Tech-Long Packaging Machinery Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou Tech-Long Packaging Machinery Co.,Ltd. specializes in the creation and distribution of complete beverage packaging systems, operating both within China and across international markets. The company's diverse product range includes water purification and pre-treatment installations, blow molding equipment, various types of filling machines (including specific container fillers), and integrated monoblock units that perform blowing, filling, and capping in a single process. Additionally, they supply labeling machinery, efficient conveying systems, general packaging equipment, blow molds, and necessary spare parts. Their capabilities also extend to advanced packaging and industrial automation solutions, alongside specialized industrial software. This company was founded in 1998 and is based in Guangzhou, China.
